create_estimator_clone: clone a scikit-learn estimator to create an unfitted copy with the same parameters
create_estimator_params: get or set parameters of a scikit-learn estimator using get_params and set_params methods
test_classifier_predict: test a classifier estimator by fitting on training data and predicting labels on test data
test_transformer_fit_transform: test a transformer estimator by fitting and transforming input data in one call
create_custom_estimator: create a custom scikit-learn estimator by inheriting from BaseEstimator and ClassifierMixin
